concerns: No street address anywhere on the course pages, only the city in each date row, so venue_name is empty (city per session; parent city set only when all sessions share one).
Prices are shown as 'From GBP x' (course may have variants); stored as 'Course fee · From' per session. If a course page has a differently priced session the per-session _price_gbp carries it.

Courses without dates (complications masterclass, 1-to-1 training, entry-level mentorship, RPEL diploma) are skipped; the listing shows no dates so the extractor reads each of the ~12 course pages (1 s gap) in list_shells_override.
Parent start_date is the earliest upcoming session even if that session is FULL (as alsg.py does); sessions carry the sold_out status.
Related dated conference pages on the same site (ace-conference-exhibition, interface-expo, bcam, baman, wigmore-presents) are not under /courses/ and were not onboarded.

Coverage checklist: multi-day ranges n/a (all one-day or per-date starts; Level 7 is 7 face-to-face days but dated per start); fees are on the same page (no external 'here' link, no image tables, no PDF); no same-site Registration sub-page (Buy Now goes to cart); CPD points read from the 'N CPD points' bullet.
